== Title ==
<span lang="ja">ショーン・ヴァルデス</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ショーンと同じ位置で自分が戦闘を宣言した時、隣接した位置にいる、このターンまだ戦闘を行っていない自分の兵員／トルーパーをその位置に即座に移動させることができる。この際、移動のためのフォースは通常通りに消費する。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">経験豊かな撤退作戦士官。エコー基地兵員のリーダー。反乱軍施設の撤退を最大効率で行い、時間を短縮するよう訓練を受けている。詩人にしてミュージシャン。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Shawn Valdez.

'''Lore''' — An experienced evacuation officer. Leader of the Echo Base troopers. He is trained to evacuate Rebel facilities at maximum efficiency and shorten the time. A poet and a musician.

'''Game text''' — When you declare a battle at the same location as Shawn, your personnel or troopers at adjacent locations may immediately move there. Only those who have not battled this turn may move. Force for this movement is consumed as usual.

== Comparison with the English printing ==
The Japanese uses 位置 for site and 兵員／トルーパー for troopers. It says Force for the move is consumed as usual. リーダー and ミュージシャン are underlined.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-L-shawnvaldez-decipher-archive.gif|Original English face]], [[Shawn Valdez]].</ref>
